watch.readinessNote: The connector is an AsaApi plugin (TakaroAsa.dll) inside ArkAscendedServer.exe, proven on game 96.9 (Steam build 26334129) with AsaApi 2.03. AsaApi resolves the game from an offset cache keyed on the sha256 of the server exe and published by community CDNs, so a new build stays down until that cache exists, and every new build needs a live retest before it is declared.

mod.description: The release zip unpacked into ShooterGame/Binaries/Win64: the pinned AsaApi release (AsaApiLoader.exe and ArkApi/) and the TakaroAsa plugin in ArkApi/Plugins/TakaroAsa, which holds the Takaro connection itself; no sidecar
